newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia regular gasoline consumption dips 0.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Colombia regular gasoline consumption dips 0.4 pct.

text.p: Colombia's domestic consumption of regular gasoline fell 0.4 percent to an average 117,000 barrels per day in 1996, the state-run oil company Ecopetrol said Monday.
Premium gasoline consumption, meanwhile, increased 6.4 percent to a daily average of 11,500 barrels. Premium gasoline prices were liberalized in 1996.
Diesel consumption increased 7 percent to 56,000 barrels per day, the Ecopetrol statement said.
Colombia produced an average 102,000 barrels of gasoline per day in 1996, an additional 30 percent was imported to cover domestic needs, an Ecopetrol spokesman said.
